intro: Wake up recharged! Our Orthomatic Deluxe mattress offers cooling comfort, orthopaedic support, and plush fabric—so you can sleep deeply, wake refreshed, and seize every day with renewed energy.

features.title: Back support that keeps you comfortable
features.text: Improve posture and wake up pain-free! Our mattress promotes spinal alignment, so you sleep better and feel better every morning.

features.title: Layers designed for cloud-like comfort
features.text: Let your bed support you! This design contours to your body, relieving pressure points and providing personalised comfort.

features.title: Fabric that regulates temperature
features.text: Overheating at night is a thing of the past thanks to our breathable design, which promotes airflow across your mattress to help you sleep cooler and more comfortably.

features.title: Luxurious fabric for extra comfort
features.text: Our plush comfort layer adds cloud-like softness to your bed, while staying breathable to keep you cool all night long.

features.title: Dual sides for versatile use
features.text: Choose your perfect level of comfort with our dual-firmness design. Whether you prefer plush softness or firmer support, your sleep is entirely up to you.

features.title: Tailored sizing for any bed frame
features.text: Our customisable dimensions ensure a seamless fit for beds of all shapes and sizes.

name: Orthomatic Deluxe Single Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 30 X 5 Inches
